fb_text:
I didn't set out to build software. I set out to get my phone back.

I run a commercial plant service in Atlanta — 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area — and my phone was the office. Gate codes. "When were we last there?" "Did anyone get to the third floor today?" Every question came to me, usually at dinner.

So I built the thing I wanted. My crew texts notes between stops like they always did — no app, no login, no training. The difference is everything they send lands somewhere that answers questions. Mine. Theirs. The next hire's.

I still run my own business on it every day. It's called FieldNotes.

Try it free for 30 days, no credit card — start with the 60-second demo:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
